description: An Amazon Comprehend endpoint that hosts a custom entity recognizer model for real-time inference.

Key.description: The initial part of a key-value pair that forms a tag associated with a given resource.

Value.description: The second part of a key-value pair that forms a tag associated with a given resource.

Arn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the entity recognizer endpoint.

EndpointName.description: The name of the endpoint. The name must be unique within the AWS Region and account.

ModelArn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the entity recognizer model to which the endpoint is attached.

DesiredInferenceUnits.description: The desired number of inference units to be used by the model. Each inference unit represents throughput of 100 characters per second.

CurrentInferenceUnits.description: The number of inference units currently used by the model using this endpoint.

EndpointStatus.description: The current status of the endpoint. Because the endpoint updates and creation are asynchronous, wait for the endpoint to be IN_SERVICE before making inference requests.

DataAccessRoleArn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the IAM role that grants Amazon Comprehend read access to trained custom models encrypted with a customer managed key (ModelKmsKeyId).

FlywheelArn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the flywheel to which the endpoint is attached.

CreationTime.description: The creation date and time of the endpoint.

LastModifiedTime.description: The date and time that the endpoint was last modified.

Tags.description: Tags associated with the endpoint being created.
